systems.system: PRODIGY IT equipment kit for commune civil registration offices
systems.platform: one desktop computer, one central unit, one multifunction printer and one uninterruptible power supply per commune
systems.owner: PRODIGY (World Bank-financed), under the Presidency's PREA; the commune's civil registrar is responsible for it
systems.tiers: planned for the civil registration offices of all 1,695 communes, stated as the country's total number of communes (plan of June 2020)

systems.country_label: informatisation du système d'enregistrement des faits d'état civil
systems.tiers: planned for all municipalities: births, marriages and deaths in the 1,695 communes

note: An e-waste management plan of June 2020: it sets out the equipment each commune is to receive and names no connection for commune offices.
